title: melissa caroliniana
intro: Melissa caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina lemon balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and native to the southeastern United States. This plant is known for its calming properties and is used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Melissa caroliniana include its ability to ease anxiety, improve sleep quality, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-anxiogenic effects.
